purpose: Keep business identifiers and values, remove migration sequence noise from visible Gherkin.

allowed: Feature/Scenario business names such as Policy 3 or SD3
Scenario Outline Examples and JSON values
regulated class codes, limits, years and counts when passed as parameters
notAllowedInStepWording: sequence prefixes such as 01, Item 09 or Step 3
hard-coded class codes that should be data
conversion: move business numbers into Examples or flat JSON
collapse repeated low-level steps into a named composite workflow
use current/next location semantics inside page workflows

gherkin.scenarioOutlineOnlyWhen: two or more concrete instances share the same workflow
gherkin.bindings: domain-oriented and reusable; feature-scoped only for generated composite journeys

data.examplesColumns: select up to four meaningful values that vary across rows
